ENTRIES:
- 2026-08-27 "Previewing the Model Hardware Standard" (research preview)
  -> https://www.anthropic.com/news/model-hardware-standard-research-preview
  MHS = shared specification for AI agents to safely operate physical devices. Co-developed with HHMI Janelia
  Research Campus. Standardized software driver translating between operating systems and hardware devices.
  Primitives: "read" (retrieve data e.g. temperature) and "write" (set parameters).
  Device discovery: devices become discoverable in a standardized format so agents and instruments locate each
  other across networks with no custom translator programs.
  Device metadata: drivers carry natural-language tags documenting weight, capabilities and SAFETY LIMITS,
  auto-generating the reference files agents need for safe operation.
  Three control interfaces working together for multi-device orchestration: Model Context Protocol (MCP),
  command-line interfaces, and code file APIs.
  Device classes demonstrated: liquid handlers, 6-DoF robotic arms, microplate readers, two-photon and light-sheet
  microscopy, thermocyclers, qPCR instruments, centrifuges, incubators, cameras, sensors, laser systems, optics.
  Research preview partners: Genentech, University of Washington (Baker/Pinglay labs), Carnegie Mellon University,
  HHMI Janelia, QuEra Computing, Tetsuwan Scientific.
  Platform partners building native MHS support: AWS/Strands, Tecan, QIAGEN, Universal Robots.
  Safety controls: device-level safety limits enforced by MHS drivers (laser power, mechanical ranges); agents
  "often stopped to wait for human confirmation before performing an action it deemed even slightly risky";
  CMU induced six failure scenarios (missing plate, rotated plate, reader busy, disconnected camera, unreachable
  device, emergency stop) and the system "correctly blocked all six before any device moved".
  Model agnostic - not tied to Claude. Applications at modelhardwarestandard.com. Anthropic plans to open-source
  the standard so any device manufacturer in any industry can adopt it.
  NOTE: modelhardwarestandard.com is an application gate only - the technical spec is restricted to approved
  preview participants. No public spec document or SDK link.

- 2026-08-27 "Expanding our support for scientists"
  Claude Science (launched June 2026) access expansion; AI for Science Program broadened beyond biological
  sciences; new Claude Team Plan for Scientists - 10,000 seats free / discounted for one year; premium seats with
  5x limits at $15/month; PI at academic or nonprofit institutions; biology/chemistry researchers limited to
  Opus-class models; up to $50,000 in credits per project.
  NO new product, API, connector or agent surface. Below reporting bar.
